purpose: Measure broader prepared-population reachability of the unchanged 76-record direct Discovery substrate without replacing or rerunning S3.

postS3DecisionAuthority.unresolvedQuestion: Whether the original first-512 reachable sample was too alphabetically concentrated to support a broader statement about reachability of the existing 76-key substrate.

populationAuthority.reachablePopulationCountPolicy: Not materialized in the definition lane. Execution applies the unchanged reachability predicate to the predeclared selected inputs and reports VALID_INPUT_COUNT.
populationAuthority.ordering: Normalize NFC, trim, lower-case with the existing English CMUdict convention; retain ASCII alphabetic normalized words; deduplicate; compare by Unicode code point ascending.
populationAuthority.eligibilityPredicate: Population-spec entry eligibility=ELIGIBLE, followed by the existing normalized ASCII lexical-word filter and lexical-word deduplication.
populationAuthority.preparationPredicate: Remove the frozen M7 prepared-word exclusion set plus the separately frozen inherited ASCII substrate-derived exclusion set listed above; current substrate modules, substrate keys, generated query keys, and candidate responses are not read during selection; no new exclusions are permitted.
reachabilityPredicate: authorized usable production pronunciation/profile is defined
canonical spoken Voice path is non-null and non-empty
existing structural hypothesis/DeepRoot query-generation machinery produces structural state
at least one generic query key is generated before substrate response lookup
substrate response, candidate count, candidate form, gloss, and semantic attractiveness are not consulted for selection

candidatesReviewed: deterministic systematic sampling across the entire ordered population
samplingDesign.whySelected: The prepared population is already frozen and ordered. Equal ordinal strata span the complete ordered population, directly correct the first-512 alphabetical concentration, require no randomness, do not overweight rare initials, and use no current substrate or candidate response; the inherited seven-form exclusion set is frozen before selection.
samplingDesign.sampleSizeJustification: 1024 is the smallest reviewed bounded size selected for this diagnostic: it doubles the original 512-input support, places one input in each of 1024 equal ordinal strata across 117389 prepared inputs, and remains deterministic and inexpensive without selecting multiple sizes.
samplingDesign.stratumDefinition: For stratum i in [0,1023], use the 1-indexed prepared-population interval [floor(i*N/1024)+1, floor((i+1)*N/1024)] where N=117389.
samplingDesign.withinStratumSelectionRule: Select the lower endpoint of every non-empty stratum exactly once.
samplingDesign.tieBreakRule: None; prepared lexical words are unique and ordinal positions are unique.
samplingDesign.duplicatePolicy: No duplicate prepared lexical word may enter the sample; duplicate source variants were already collapsed by the frozen lexical-word population rule.
samplingDesign.sampleIdentityMaterializationBoundary: The definition freezes the algorithm only. Execution may derive and fingerprint input identities before any query generation; no generated query keys or candidate outcomes may be stored as selection evidence.
samplingDesign.fullPopulationSpanProof: The first stratum begins at prepared position 1 and the final stratum ends at prepared position N; every ordinal interval is represented exactly once.

queryMatchingAuthority.matchingSemantics: normalized-exact textual equality: the source adapter matches record.lookupForm === input.embryo after the existing NFC/trim query normalization contract.

predeclaredQuestions.primary: Within the broader deterministic sample of the existing prepared eligible population, what fraction of distinct generated generic query keys intersects the unchanged 76-record direct Discovery substrate?
secondary: How many of the 76 substrate query keys are reached at least once?
How many Albanian substrate keys are reached?
How many Latin substrate keys are reached?
Do any of the 13 currently structurally-generatable ASCII Latin keys occur?
Do any of the 8 currently non-generatable diacritic Latin keys occur?
How does the broader-sample reachability compare descriptively with the original frozen S3 sample?

predeclaredMetrics.validInputCount: number of selected inputs satisfying the unchanged reachability predicate before substrate response lookup
predeclaredMetrics.totalQueryKeyOccurrences: sum of generated generic query-key counts over valid inputs
predeclaredMetrics.distinctQueryKeys: cardinality of the union of generated generic query keys over valid inputs
predeclaredMetrics.distinctSubstrateKeysReached: cardinality of generated keys intersecting the 76-key substrate set
predeclaredMetrics.distinctAlbanianKeysReached: cardinality of reached substrate keys whose source language is Albanian
predeclaredMetrics.distinctLatinKeysReached: cardinality of reached substrate keys whose source language is Latin
predeclaredMetrics.distinctAsciiLatinKeysReached: cardinality of reached keys in the frozen 13-key ASCII Latin set
predeclaredMetrics.distinctDiacriticLatinKeysReached: cardinality of reached keys in the frozen 8-key diacritic Latin set
predeclaredMetrics.generatedKeysWithAnySubstrateRecord: number of distinct generated keys having at least one substrate record
predeclaredMetrics.inputsWithAnySubstrateIntersection: number of valid inputs with at least one generated key in the substrate
predeclaredMetrics.inputsWithAlbanianIntersection: number of valid inputs with at least one generated Albanian substrate key
predeclaredMetrics.inputsWithLatinIntersection: number of valid inputs with at least one generated Latin substrate key
predeclaredMetrics.multipleSubstrateKeyInputs: number of valid inputs reaching more than one distinct substrate key

s3ComparisonBoundary.comparison: Descriptive only; the broader sample is not combined with, treated as independent of, or substituted for S3.
s3ComparisonBoundary.headlineContextWording: On the frozen S3 sample, the current 76-record substrate covered 1 of the 1,085 distinct query keys generated by those 512 inputs (0.0921658986175%).

interpretationClasses.CLASS_A_BROADER_SAMPLE_REVEALS_NO_ADDITI: The broader sample reaches only the same substrate-key set as S3; this is evidence about the bounded diagnostic and does not authorize a new source or architecture change.
interpretationClasses.CLASS_B_BROADER_SAMPLE_REVEALS_ADDITIONA: The broader sample reaches additional existing substrate keys but no Latin key; sample support and Latin/source-key coverage remain separate limitations.
interpretationClasses.CLASS_C_BROADER_SAMPLE_REVEALS_ONE_OR_MO: The broader sample reaches one or more current ASCII Latin keys; S3 remains valid but its zero-Latin result is not generalized to the broader population.
interpretationClasses.CLASS_D_OTHER_PREDECLARED_RESULT: Any mechanically possible result not covered by A-C, including diacritic-key behavior under unchanged normalization.

selectionInputsUsed: separately frozen inherited ASCII substrate-derived exclusion set
selectionInputsNotUsed: current Albanian substrate module or source forms
